parameters.content:
## Stages workflow
- Work is organized in sequential stages
- each stage has parallel tasks
- each stage can only start once the previous stage taske are completed

Worker1.subtask: Build the WEST half of the foundation floor using oak_planks. Place a 4x7 floor from X:0-3, Z:0-6 at Y:-60.
Worker1.objective: Build the WEST half of the house (X: 0-3)
Worker1.fullPrompt:
You are Worker1 positioned at X=0, Y=-60, Z=0. Do NOT move or pathfind. Begin building immediately.

STAGE 1 of 4: Foundation (West Half)

TASK: Build the WEST half of the floor using oak_planks.

COORDINATES:
- X: 0 to 3 (4 blocks wide)
- Z: 0 to 6 (7 blocks deep)
- Y: -60 (floor level)

Total blocks: 4 x 7 = 28 oak_planks

CONSTRAINTS:
- Do NOT place blocks beyond X=3
- Do NOT break existing blocks unless necessary
- Do NOT place blocks in Worker2's area (X >= 4)
- Assume you have 64 oak_planks in inventory

Worker2 is simultaneously building the east foundation (X:4-6). Your floors will connect seamlessly.
constraints: Do NOT place blocks beyond X=3
Do NOT break more than 20 sequential blocks
Assume Worker2 is building east foundation (X:4-6) simultaneously
Use oak_planks for the floor

Worker2.subtask: Build the EAST half of the foundation floor using oak_planks. Place a 3x7 floor from X:4-6, Z:0-6 at Y:-60.
Worker2.objective: Build the EAST half of the house (X: 4-6)
Worker2.fullPrompt:
You are Worker2 positioned at X=4, Y=-60, Z=0. Do NOT move or pathfind. Begin building immediately.

STAGE 1 of 4: Foundation (East Half)

TASK: Build the EAST half of the floor using oak_planks.

COORDINATES:
- X: 4 to 6 (3 blocks wide)
- Z: 0 to 6 (7 blocks deep)
- Y: -60 (floor level)

Total blocks: 3 x 7 = 21 oak_planks

CONSTRAINTS:
- Do NOT place blocks below X=4
- Do NOT break existing blocks unless necessary
- Do NOT place blocks in Worker1's area (X <= 3)
- Assume you have 64 oak_planks in inventory

Worker1 is simultaneously building the west foundation (X:0-3). Your floors will connect seamlessly at X=3/4 boundary.
constraints: Do NOT place blocks below X=4
Do NOT break more than 20 sequential blocks
Assume Worker1 is building west foundation (X:0-3) simultaneously
Use oak_planks for the floor

Worker1.subtask: Build the WEST and NORTH walls using oak_log corners and oak_planks walls. Include a door opening on the west wall (Z:2-3). Walls are 3 blocks high (Y:-59 to Y:-57).
Worker1.objective: Build the WEST half of the house (X: 0-3)
Worker1.fullPrompt:
You are Worker1 positioned at X=0, Y=-59, Z=0. Do NOT move or pathfind. Begin building immediately.

STAGE 2 of 4: Walls (West and North)

TASK: Build the WEST wall (X=0) and NORTH wall (Z=0, X:0-3).

WALL SPECIFICATIONS:
- Height: 3 blocks (Y:-59 to Y:-57)
- Material: oak_log for corners, oak_planks for walls

WEST WALL (X=0, Z:0-6):
- Corner posts at (0,-59 to -57, 0) and (0,-59 to -57, 6) using oak_log
- Wall fill between corners using oak_planks
- DOOR OPENING: Leave empty at X=0, Z=2-3, Y=-59 to -58

NORTH WALL (Z=0, X:0-3):
- Connect from corner at X=0 to X=3
- Use oak_planks
- Worker2 will continue this wall from X=4-6

CONSTRAINTS:
- Do NOT place blocks beyond X=3
- Do NOT place wall at X=3, Z=0 (that's the boundary - Worker2 connects there)
- Assume you have 64 oak_logs and 128 oak_planks

Worker2 is building east wall (X=6) and south wall (Z=6) simultaneously.
constraints: Do NOT place blocks beyond X=3
Do NOT break more than 20 sequential blocks
Leave door opening at X=0, Z=2-3, Y=-59 to -58 (2 blocks high)
Use oak_log for corners at (0,0), (0,6)
Use oak_planks for walls between corners
Assume Worker2 is building east and south walls simultaneously

Worker2.subtask: Build the EAST and SOUTH walls using oak_log corners and oak_planks walls. Include a window opening on the east wall. Walls are 3 blocks high (Y:-59 to Y:-57).
Worker2.objective: Build the EAST half of the house (X: 4-6)
Worker2.fullPrompt:
You are Worker2 positioned at X=6, Y=-59, Z=0. Do NOT move or pathfind. Begin building immediately.

STAGE 2 of 4: Walls (East and South)

TASK: Build the EAST wall (X=6) and SOUTH wall (Z=6, X:4-6) and complete NORTH wall (Z=0, X:4-6).

WALL SPECIFICATIONS:
- Height: 3 blocks (Y:-59 to Y:-57)
- Material: oak_log for corners, oak_planks for walls

EAST WALL (X=6, Z:0-6):
- Corner posts at (6,-59 to -57, 0) and (6,-59 to -57, 6) using oak_log
- Wall fill between corners using oak_planks
- WINDOW OPENING: Leave empty at X=6, Z=3, Y=-58

SOUTH WALL (Z=6, X:4-6):
- Connect from corner at X=6 toward X=4
- Use oak_planks
- Worker1's corner at (0,6) already placed

NORTH WALL CONTINUATION (Z=0, X:4-6):
- Continue from X=4 to corner at X=6
- Use oak_planks

CONSTRAINTS:
- Do NOT place blocks below X=4 on south wall
- Complete the wall connections to Worker1's sections
- Assume you have 64 oak_logs and 128 oak_planks

Worker1 is building west wall and north wall (X:0-3) simultaneously.
constraints: Do NOT place blocks below X=4 (except connecting north/south walls)
Do NOT break more than 20 sequential blocks
Leave window opening at X=6, Z=3, Y=-58 (1 block)
Use oak_log for corners at (6,0), (6,6)
Use oak_planks for walls between corners
Assume Worker1 is building west and north walls simultaneously

Worker1.subtask: Build the WEST roof slope using oak_stairs. Stairs slope UPWARD from X=0 toward the CENTER RIDGE at X=3. Ridge height is Y=-54.
Worker1.objective: Build the WEST half of the house (X: 0-3)
Worker1.fullPrompt:
You are Worker1 positioned at X=0, Y=-56, Z=0. Do NOT move or pathfind. Begin building immediately.

STAGE 3 of 4: Roof (West Slope)

TASK: Build the WEST roof slope using oak_stairs sloping toward the CENTER RIDGE at X=3.

*** CRITICAL: ROOF RIDGE LOCATION ***
The roof has ONE center ridge at X=3, Y=-54.
Your stairs must slope UPWARD toward X=3.
Worker2's stairs will slope UPWARD toward X=3 from the east.
Both slopes meet at X=3 to form a single peaked roof.

ROOF CONSTRUCTION:
Row 1 (Y=-56): Place oak_stairs at X=0, Z:0-6, facing EAST
Row 2 (Y=-55): Place oak_stairs at X=1, Z:0-6, facing EAST  
Row 3 (Y=-55): Place oak_stairs at X=2, Z:0-6, facing EAST
Ridge (Y=-54): Place oak_planks at X=3, Z:0-6 (ridge cap)

STAIR ORIENTATION:
- All stairs face EAST (toward ridge at X=3)
- Each row steps up as X increases toward ridge

CONSTRAINTS:
- Do NOT place stairs beyond X=3
- Do NOT create any ridge other than at X=3
- Ensure seamless connection with Worker2's east slope at ridge
- Assume you have 64 oak_stairs and 16 oak_planks

Worker2 is building the east roof slope (X:4-6) simultaneously, sloping toward X=3.
constraints: Roof ridge is at X=3 (center of building)
Your stairs slope TOWARD X=3 (facing east)
Do NOT create a separate ridge on your side
Worker2's roof will meet yours at X=3
Use oak_stairs facing EAST (toward ridge)

Worker2.subtask: Build the EAST roof slope using oak_stairs. Stairs slope UPWARD from X=6 toward the CENTER RIDGE at X=3. Ridge height is Y=-54.
Worker2.objective: Build the EAST half of the house (X: 4-6)
Worker2.fullPrompt:
You are Worker2 positioned at X=6, Y=-56, Z=0. Do NOT move or pathfind. Begin building immediately.

STAGE 3 of 4: Roof (East Slope)

TASK: Build the EAST roof slope using oak_stairs sloping toward the CENTER RIDGE at X=3.

*** CRITICAL: ROOF RIDGE LOCATION ***
The roof has ONE center ridge at X=3, Y=-54.
Your stairs must slope UPWARD toward X=3.
Worker1's stairs slope UPWARD toward X=3 from the west.
Both slopes meet at X=3 to form a single peaked roof.

ROOF CONSTRUCTION:
Row 1 (Y=-56): Place oak_stairs at X=6, Z:0-6, facing WEST
Row 2 (Y=-55): Place oak_stairs at X=5, Z:0-6, facing WEST
Row 3 (Y=-55): Place oak_stairs at X=4, Z:0-6, facing WEST

Note: Worker1 places the ridge cap at X=3. Your stairs connect to that ridge.

STAIR ORIENTATION:
- All stairs face WEST (toward ridge at X=3)
- Each row steps up as X decreases toward ridge

CONSTRAINTS:
- Your stairs connect TO the ridge at X=3 (Worker1 places ridge cap)
- Do NOT create any separate ridge
- Ensure seamless connection with Worker1's west slope at X=3
- Assume you have 64 oak_stairs

Worker1 is building the west roof slope (X:0-3) and ridge cap simultaneously.
constraints: Roof ridge is at X=3 (center of building)
Your stairs slope TOWARD X=3 (facing west)
Do NOT create a separate ridge on your side
Worker1's roof meets yours at X=3
Use oak_stairs facing WEST (toward ridge)

Worker1.subtask: Add interior details to the WEST half: place an oak_door in the door opening, add a crafting_table, and place torches for lighting.
Worker1.objective: Build the WEST half of the house (X: 0-3)
Worker1.fullPrompt:

STAGE 4 of 4: Interior and Finishing (West Half)

TASK: Add interior finishing touches to the west half of the house.

ITEMS TO PLACE:
1. DOOR: Place oak_door at X=0, Z=2, Y=-59 (bottom) and Y=-58 (top)
   - Door faces WEST (opens outward)

2. CRAFTING TABLE: Place crafting_table at X=1, Y=-59, Z=1
   - In northwest corner of interior

3. TORCHES: Place torches for lighting
   - Torch at X=0, Y=-57, Z=3 (west wall)
   - Torch at X=2, Y=-57, Z=0 (north wall)

CONSTRAINTS:
- Do NOT place items beyond X=3
- Do NOT break any walls, floor, or roof
- Do NOT block the door opening
- Assume you have 2 oak_door, 1 crafting_table, 4 torches

Worker2 is adding finishing touches to the east half simultaneously.
constraints: Do NOT place items beyond X=3
Do NOT break any existing structure
Place door at X=0, Z=2-3
Place crafting_table in west interior
Place torches on walls for lighting
